topic: IGP- submission has been in queue for almost 24 hrs now

messages.content: Hi everyone , @YZ @SAIRadmin - our submission has been in queue for almost 24 hrs now, just checking if everyone is facing the same problem or is it just us? this is the first time our submissions have been in queue for this long
messages.subject: IGP- submission has been in queue for almost 24 hrs now

messages.content:
@Durgesh You can see on the discovery page:
"Processed 34,395,070 Pending 1,861,362"
So it's just slowly processing a massive queue, likely still a day before that will be done...
Similar things have happened several times before in recent weeks, it's generally a single user submitting millions of polynomials at a time and clogging things up, labeling locally without magma can be pretty slow so that is the main limitation for most users, ai seems to often decide the best solution is to "just let the server do all the work" :upside_down:
